acceptance_criteria: HMI renders an ordered SOP phase-results section for PHASE_1 through PHASE_4 from payload.phase_results.
Each phase card shows phase, decision, reason codes, authority blockers, and production-authority state.
Each phase card exposes rule id, rule decision, rule reason codes, and compact evidence summary when rule_results are present.
Missing or empty phase_results renders a safe empty state.
Existing top-level decision, phase, reasons, measurements, replay refresh, websocket updates, and feedback form behavior continue to work.
Browser verification records HMI phase-results drilldown evidence on /hmi.
